key_values.text: 軟體程式設計、軟體工程系統開發、模組化系統設計

key_values.label: 其他條件
key_values.text:
Other Relevant/Helpful Skills:
• Experience with Python and FastAPI
• Experience leveraging AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, etc.) to accelerate development
• Personal projects built with AI assistance
• Familiarity with using AI tools to assist with research, learning, and problem-solving
• Proficiency in at least two programming language of choice
• Proficiency in at least one unit testing framework (JUnit, RSpec, your own?)
• Authorship of, or commits to, a public or private code framework (super bonus!)
• Experience with SQL and relational databases (Oracle, Postgres)
• Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript
• Java and JVM experience or C/C++ and compiler experience
• Experience with HTML/CSS/SASS
• Formal performance analysis and benchmarking
• Knowledge of statistical methods, modeling, and/or discrete mathematics
